candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` so the stored timestamp never updates.
Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` with `pastBlockTime = block.number;` so the stored value is a block number instead of a timestamp.
Delete the `require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime);` check so multiple calls in the same block are allowed.
Delete the `require(msg.value == 10 ether);` check so any value is accepted.
Replace the modulo condition `block.number % 15 == 0` with `block.number % 15 != 0`, inverting when payouts occur.
Replace the payout amount `address(this).balance` with `0`, so no funds are transferred on winning blocks.
Remove the assignment `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` so the public getter `pastBlockTime()` never updates.
Change the timestamp guard from strict `>` to `>=`, allowing multiple calls in the same block and thus changing whether transfers occur.
Change the modulo constant from 15 to 7 so the payout triggers on a different set of block numbers.
Change the modulo comparison to `% 15 != 0`, inverting the block-number condition under which the payout occurs.
Delete the `require(msg.value == 10 ether);` guard so calls with any value are accepted and mutate state.
Replace the full-balance transfer with a transfer of only `msg.value`, changing the amount paid out.
